assumptions: annual means only: the seasonal cycle of insolation and the 2 mbar seasonal CO2 cap are outside the model
one atmosphere, well mixed: the CO2 partial pressure is uniform over the planet at every instant
the greenhouse is a flux proportional to a power of the CO2 pressure, calibrated to two published ends (20 mbar -> <10 K, 1 bar -> ~60 K); its shape between and beyond them is an assumption
an engineered greenhouse is applied as a flux in W/m2, with no chemistry, lifetime or source
radiative equilibrium is reached locally apart from the zonal transport: no dynamics, no dust lifting, no clouds, no water cycle, no topography
the heat capacity is one mixed layer of atmosphere and regolith skin, the same at every latitude
the polar cap is a zonal film whose extent is set by the frost point at the current pressure; its thickness is uniform, and its total is Jakosky & Edwards' polar reservoir
the regolith releases its CO2 at a single e-folding time, not through a thermal diffusion front
